description: Send a carousel of cards (title, subtitle, image, up to 3 buttons each; max 10 cards) to a Messenger or Instagram contact. Provide the recipient PSID/IGSID and platform.

buttons.description: Up to 3 buttons. Each is a URL button {type:"web_url",title,url} or postback {type:"postback",title,payload}.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to send this carousel.

platform.description: Which Meta channel to send from. Defaults to messenger.

name: send_carousel
